Cloud-Soft Chocolate Mousse Cups

A chickpea-water kitchen trick turns into a fluffy, chocolatey dessert. This cookbook version keeps the airy idea and adds Greek yogurt plus whey for a more satisfying protein hit.

Prep
15 min
Cook
Not listed
Total
Not listed
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
5

Ingredients

  • ½ cup aquafaba (liquid from 1 can chickpeas)
  • 170 g plain nonfat Greek yogurt
  • 1 scoop chocolate or unflavored whey isolate
  • 1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder
  • 1–2 tbsp sugar-free maple-style syrup, to taste
  • ¼ tsp cream of tartar or lemon juice (optional, helps whip) (optional)
  • Fresh berries or cocoa dust, to finish (optional) (optional)

Amounts are scaled from 2 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Chill two small serving glasses. Pour chickpea liquid into a clean, dry bowl. Add cream of tartar if using.
  2. Whip with an electric mixer until very fluffy and holding firm peaks, about 6–10 minutes.
  3. In another bowl, whisk yogurt, whey, cocoa and syrup until smooth. Taste and add a little more syrup if you like.
  4. Fold one big spoonful of whipped aquafaba into the chocolate mixture to loosen it. Gently fold in the rest in two additions, keeping as much air as possible.
  5. Spoon into glasses and chill at least 30 minutes. Finish with berries or a dusting of cocoa.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
